name: Ram
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy

points: Pharez begat Hezron, Hezron begat Ram, Ram begat Amminadab, Amminadab begat Nahshon, Nahshon begat Salmon, Salmon begat Boaz, Boaz begat Obed, Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: The sons of Hezron are named, and the line is carried through Ram down to Amminadab, Nahshon, Salmon, Boaz, Obed, and Jesse.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 2: The Sons of Israel and the Line of Judah

points: Hezron begat Ram, Ram begat Amminadab, Amminadab begat Nahshon the prince of the children of Judah, and from Nahshon come Salma, Boaz, Obed and Jesse.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah
